title: Lacto Fermented American Cabbage Slaw
description: A crunchy and tangy lacto-fermented slaw made with American cabbage, perfect for midnight cravings. This recipe features a bitter and crisp flavor profile.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, grated carrots, and thinly sliced onions.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the garlic mixture to the cabbage mixture and toss to combine.
Pack the mixture into a large glass jar or container, pressing down on the vegetables to remove any air pockets.
Pour the buttermilk over the vegetables, making sure that they are completely covered.
Cover the jar or container with a lid or plastic wrap and let it ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
After 24 hours, transfer the jar or container to the refrigerator to slow down the fermentation process.
Let the slaw ferment for an additional 24 hours in the refrigerator before serving.
Before serving, give the slaw a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
